selection_rule: Select the smallest exact candidate width passing control mean recall@10 >=0.95, control p05 query recall@10 >=0.80, zero cache reads, and control p95 <=200ms. Break ties by backing reads, backing bytes, p95, then p50. This is a refinement-width diagnostic, not a production promotion.
evidence_boundary: One fresh immutable full Cohere Medium 1M index and all 1,000 shipped queries. Nprobe is fixed at 32. Candidate widths are evaluated with the exact-rerank control; the repeated approximate-first arm is structural paired evidence only. Incomplete JSONL is never inspected. The result identifies a quality knee but cannot establish S3 latency, 100M scalability, modality parity, or competitor claims.
